## Fictional retention
At Soravin Specimen Studio, conservation cards are kept for 80 days. If a treatment review is open, retain the affected cards until the review is closed, even after the 80-day period.

## Fictional copy requests
At Soravin Specimen Studio, a public copy request received before 16:00 is sent the same operating day. At or after 16:00, send it on the next operating day. If the custody review is unresolved, do not send the copy until that review closes.
